compaction: One record for all three phases. Raw timing/RSS samples and hashes keep their original precision. Recomputable median/min/max fields, duplicated profiles and non-timing dictionary counters are omitted. Per-run first/repeated query milliseconds share the queries/matches arrays. Full original reports, traces and probes are archived locally and remain in git at the accepted implementation commit.
